name: playback-log
title: Playback Log
summary: Test patch: records shuffle, playback and memory.

actions.title: Clear the Playback Log
actions.status: The playback log is empty. The iPod writes the log after a button press.

steps: Flash a firmware with this patch and the patches that you use.
Click Eject iPod. Then disconnect the iPod.
Do the steps that cause the problem, for example Shuffle Songs. Let the first song play to its end.
When the music stops, press a button or turn the wheel. The iPod writes the log.
Wait 15 seconds, so that the firmware writes the log to the disk.
Connect the iPod to the Mac and click Show Playback Log.
Click Save the Log to Share or Report on GitHub. Then send the file to the developer.

description: Use the log to find why the music stops.
caution: Do not install this patch together with USB Host Probe. The two patches use the same hook site.
details: The log has the shuffle, the songs, the memory, the settings and the patches.
A button press writes the log to the disk, at most one time each 5 seconds.
Click Show Playback Log to see the log.
notes: Show the log before a new sync, because a sync can change the song IDs.
The log keeps 32 KB. When it is full, the iPod removes the oldest half of the lines.
The patch uses 38849 bytes of RAM. Thus the free memory is approximately 38 KB less.
